verdictReason.description: One line completing "Verdict: Request Changes — …". States why, not what.

summary.description: The spec in one line, what was verified and how, and what could not be assessed.

notes.description: Spec-vs-implementation assessment plus the scope-creep callout: style churn, drive-by renames, and changes serving no line of the spec.

scope.description: The scope contract, declared before fan-out.

claim.description: One or two sentences: what the PR claims to do.

methodology.description: How the review establishes whether it does: personas, seats, checks planned, whether a preview exists. Record "single-model degraded" here when fewer than 3 external seats were available.

seat.description: Seat id from runner discovery, or "native"

executionPath.description: Effective transport, e.g. "codex-runner --effort high" or "Agent model:opus"

scope.description: What it covered, e.g. "all changed handlers and their tests"

sampling.description: Declared sampling: size and how instances were chosen.

coverage.description: Every will-review and spot-check file with its outcome. A declared file missing here is a broken contract.

note.description: Required when outcome is skipped: what forced the skip.

checks.description: Each check actually run, embedded verbatim from verify-changes when it ran. Item shape owned by verify-changes/references/checks-schema.json.

items.$comment: Structurally identical to the check item in verify-changes/references/checks-schema.json — that file is the owning definition.

notes.description: What was observed — or why the preview was skipped.

findings.description: Anchored defects that survived the adversarial verifier. Empty is a valid result.

path.description: Repo-relative path, on a line the diff touches

title.description: One specific line naming the defect

body.description: Actionable verbatim: what's wrong, where, why it matters, what done looks like

comments.description: Observations with no single-line anchor: cross-file issues, PR-wide concerns.

severity.description: P0 breaks production or leaks data; P1 must be fixed before merge; P2 should be fixed but does not block; P3 is minor and concrete.

path.description: A file, or a directory/change-group above ~100 files.

note.description: Why excluded, or what the group contains.
